independence.imports: Python standard library and numpy only
independence.raw_inputs: locked original NPZ plus hashed metadata; no production decoder, behavior, inspector, or translator output

conventions.force_readout_clock: t stamps the control-step recorder readout, not an observed physical force-update time; current-sensor age and history-slot times are unrecorded
conventions.invalid_padding: Ignored through valid=false; actual padding includes identity quaternion and episode_length=1 in addition to zero-filled other arrays
conventions.sample_span_vs_cell_time: N consecutive marker samples have endpoint span (N-1)*dt and bookkeeping cell-duration N*dt; neither proves physical continuous duration
conventions.interval_boundaries: Adjacent recorder-sample transitions only; force-marker brackets locate buffer-readout sequence boundaries, not physical 20ms contact-event bounds. Sensor update time/latency is unknown; physical onset/end cannot be localized from these brackets, and censored sequence boundaries remain unknown.
conventions.float_precision: raw float32 operands promoted to float64; no rounding before computations
conventions.quaternion_policy: Validate raw norm error<=1e-4, then normalize for all primary up-z, inversion runs and body-frame rotations; raw up-z fields are diagnostics only.
conventions.support_position_velocity: Recorded body_pos_w link-position and body_lin_vel_w COM-velocity channels; historical asset reference-point/COM-offset mapping is not fully verified. Do not equate recorded velocity with the exact derivative of recorded position.
conventions.low_speed_off: M04 uses norm(recorded support_lin_vel_w.xy)<0.05 m/s with current force norm<=1 N; xyz speed is diagnostic only.
conventions.contact_combination_encoding: role_index_lsb.v1: code=sum(int(marker[i])<<i); entities=[FL,FR,RL,RR], weights=[1,2,4,8]; no production ABI change.
conventions.force_semantics: recorded world net normal-contact force; tangential forces not recorded
conventions.scope: development regression/descriptive audit; source identity and entity order are required in every lookup

operands.steps: each episode valid=true prefix; no stage restriction

cohort_facts.formula: pool valid samples by archived success; sum norm(F) and signed Fz separately; share=sum_i/sum_all_feet; count each manifest outcome once
cohort_facts.allowed_meaning: R4 development cohort only, whole recorded episodes, sample-weighted current-marker and net-normal-force statistics. Not step-stage, per-episode-equal means, physical impulse truth, or E1 success.

fact_resolution: Each episode fact inherits source/run/env/chunk/step/raw-NPZ operands from raw_reference, and formula/channels/category/tolerance/allowed_meaning from fact_templates[template]. id = episode_id + '.' + template. Unabridged ledger contains all raw transitions, sample operands and facts; summaries never replace it. Values omitted here are not claims.

summary_notation.numeric_rounding: Summary floats rounded to 6 decimal places (absolute error <=5e-7), except nonzero magnitudes <1e-5 use 12 places; full ledger and NPZ retain unrounded values.
summary_notation.run_fields: steps=[first,last] inclusive; n=sample count; cell_s=n*dt; span_s=(n-1)*dt; onset_s/end_s are sample brackets or null unknown boundary; physical continuous duration is always unknown.

source_entity_clock.formula: Use source namespace; t[k]=k*0.02, k=1..N; retain exactly valid=true rows.
source_entity_clock.allowed_meaning: Only this namespaced first episode; no t=0 observation; current samples do not cover every physics substep.

archived_result_and_endpoint.formula: Outcome is copied from hashed manifest.metadata.seeds[run].outcomes[env]; endpoint is last valid NPZ row.
archived_result_and_endpoint.allowed_meaning: Archived evaluator result and recorded endpoint; a label is not an independently observed cause.

root_progress.allowed_meaning: Sampled world +x displacement/path and retreat/return; path is a sample polyline, not full continuous motion.

body_up.formula: Validate abs(norm(raw_q)-1)<=1e-4; q=raw_q/norm(raw_q); body-up world-z=1-2*(qx*qx+qy*qy). All primary values/runs use normalized q; raw values are diagnostic only.
body_up.allowed_meaning: Orientation of the recorded root. up_z<0 means its local +z points below world horizontal, not failure causation.

FL_foot.markers.formula: body_index=0; marker=norm(force_xyz)>1N; occupancy=sum(marker)/N; transitions compare adjacent samples only
FL_foot.markers.allowed_meaning: Current-force threshold marker counts and sample runs for this foot; no inference of physical flight, load share, or uninterrupted absence between samples.

FR_foot.markers.formula: body_index=1; marker=norm(force_xyz)>1N; occupancy=sum(marker)/N; transitions compare adjacent samples only
FR_foot.markers.allowed_meaning: Current-force threshold marker counts and sample runs for this foot; no inference of physical flight, load share, or uninterrupted absence between samples.

RL_foot.markers.formula: body_index=2; marker=norm(force_xyz)>1N; occupancy=sum(marker)/N; transitions compare adjacent samples only
RL_foot.markers.allowed_meaning: Current-force threshold marker counts and sample runs for this foot; no inference of physical flight, load share, or uninterrupted absence between samples.

RR_foot.markers.formula: body_index=3; marker=norm(force_xyz)>1N; occupancy=sum(marker)/N; transitions compare adjacent samples only
RR_foot.markers.allowed_meaning: Current-force threshold marker counts and sample runs for this foot; no inference of physical flight, load share, or uninterrupted absence between samples.

force_semantics.allowed_meaning: Shares of sampled recorded net normal-contact force norms or signed world-z components, separately. Neither is total force/load/body-weight support; tangential forces are absent.

contact_combinations.formula: code=sum(int(marker[i])<<i), entities=[FL,FR,RL,RR], weights=[1,2,4,8]; counts over valid current-force samples
contact_combinations.allowed_meaning: Simultaneous threshold-marker combinations; all four off does not prove whole robot airborne.

body_frame_anchors.formula: offset_body=R(normalized_wxyz).T@(support_pos_w-base_pos_w); validate raw norm error<=1e-4, then normalize; x forward, y left, z up
body_frame_anchors.allowed_meaning: Recorded body_pos_w position anchors check robot-relative left/right/front/rear; not image left/right or sole geometry. Historical link-position/COM-velocity mapping is not fully verified; no derivative equivalence is claimed.

short_terminal_events.formula: Keep every raw current-forbidden marker run (any body norm>1N), separately any-history-slot marker run, and final five frames; no duration cutoff or smoothing
short_terminal_events.allowed_meaning: Preserve even a one-sample terminal contact marker. Recorded terminal labels may have distinct detector history and are not overwritten by current-force markers.

history_and_missing_channels.formula: Compare current marker with ANY history-slot marker as two different sampled quantities; inspect actual NPZ channel inventory.
history_and_missing_channels.allowed_meaning: Three history slots are existing sensor-buffer snapshots, with unrecorded slot times and reset validity; they cannot prove full four-substep coverage. Missing inputs block exact reward/total-support claims.

FL_foot.low_speed_off.formula: body_index=0; norm(force)<=1N AND norm(recorded world xy velocity)<0.05m/s; report longest sampled run; xyz speed is diagnostic only
FL_foot.low_speed_off.allowed_meaning: The recorded support_lin_vel_w channel has low horizontal speed while its marker is off. Historical link-position/COM-velocity asset mapping is not fully verified; this is not an exact derivative of support_pos_w, sole motion, or proof of no physical contact.

FR_foot.low_speed_off.formula: body_index=1; norm(force)<=1N AND norm(recorded world xy velocity)<0.05m/s; report longest sampled run; xyz speed is diagnostic only
FR_foot.low_speed_off.allowed_meaning: The recorded support_lin_vel_w channel has low horizontal speed while its marker is off. Historical link-position/COM-velocity asset mapping is not fully verified; this is not an exact derivative of support_pos_w, sole motion, or proof of no physical contact.

RL_foot.low_speed_off.formula: body_index=2; norm(force)<=1N AND norm(recorded world xy velocity)<0.05m/s; report longest sampled run; xyz speed is diagnostic only
RL_foot.low_speed_off.allowed_meaning: The recorded support_lin_vel_w channel has low horizontal speed while its marker is off. Historical link-position/COM-velocity asset mapping is not fully verified; this is not an exact derivative of support_pos_w, sole motion, or proof of no physical contact.

RR_foot.low_speed_off.formula: body_index=3; norm(force)<=1N AND norm(recorded world xy velocity)<0.05m/s; report longest sampled run; xyz speed is diagnostic only
RR_foot.low_speed_off.allowed_meaning: The recorded support_lin_vel_w channel has low horizontal speed while its marker is off. Historical link-position/COM-velocity asset mapping is not fully verified; this is not an exact derivative of support_pos_w, sole motion, or proof of no physical contact.

required_inverted_counterexample.formula: first(normalized_up_z<0) precedes each longest front-foot (force_norm<=1N AND recorded_speed_xy<0.05m/s) run; sampled endpoint span>5s
required_inverted_counterexample.allowed_meaning: Inversion precedes prolonged low-speed front-foot marker-off; upright foot suspension is contradicted, and right-censoring prohibits complete-duration language.

required_return_counterexample.formula: Require archived success, maximum sampled x drawdown>0.1m, and a subsequent sample recovering its previous peak
required_return_counterexample.allowed_meaning: A successful recorded episode contains retreat and return; final success is not a monotone-progress claim.
